request_quote: Study the association between alcohol content and color intensity in the complete official UCI Wine dataset.
title: Alcohol and color intensity in the UCI Wine dataset: overall and cultivar-conditioned associations
relationship: Descriptive association of alcohol content with color intensity overall, within cultivar, and conditional on cultivar.
scope: Complete official UCI Wine historical dataset; sample-level descriptive associations only, without causal or population claims.
completion_criteria: Answer Q1 and Q2 with complete official local data and real analyses
Report primary experiments, robustness, real-result figures and references in a coherent English paper
Deliver editable Word and actually rendered PDF with scientific review and expression meaning check

questions.text: What are the direction and magnitude of the overall alcohol–color-intensity association?
Is the association consistent within cultivar classes and after adjusting for class?

primary_experiments.purpose: Estimate overall Pearson r, Spearman rho, and unadjusted OLS slope on all records.
Estimate class-specific slopes/correlations and the class-adjusted common slope, and examine slope heterogeneity.
